_comment: Citation for the 10e Fight-phase alternation (both armies' engaged units fight in each Fight phase, alternating one at a time across a Fights First step then a Remaining Combats step). Built env-gated behind SWEG_FIGHTALT (Group-2 #2). The two-step structure and one-at-a-time alternation are confirmed from Wahapedia (https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/core-rules/). Sources DIFFER on which player selects FIRST in each step: Wahapedia (the project's canonical source per CLAUDE.md rule 6/10) reads as the active player (the player whose turn is taking place); some secondary summaries (Bell of Lost Souls, SpikeyBits) read the non-active player first in the Fights First step. The implementation follows the Wahapedia/canonical reading (active first in both steps); the first-selector is a second-order tie-break that does not change the dominant in-phase-retaliation mechanism, and is flagged for authoritative confirmation. NOT invented — the mechanism (both armies fight in each Fight phase, alternating) is the verbatim core rule.

simulator.fight_alternation.rule_name: Fight phase — alternating activations (Fights First, then Remaining Combats)
simulator.fight_alternation.quoted_text: The Fight phase is split into two steps: 'Fights First' and 'Remaining Combats'. In the Fights First step, units that charged this turn and units that have the Fights First ability fight. In the Remaining Combats step, all other eligible units fight. In each step the players alternate selecting one of their eligible units to fight with, one at a time, until all eligible units have fought. A unit is eligible to fight if it is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units or it made a Charge move this turn.
simulator.fight_alternation.trigger: Group-2 #2 (env-gated SWEG_FIGHTALT): a Fight phase is being resolved. The vanilla loop fought ONLY the active army's units, deferring the defender's retaliation to its own later turn; under the gate, BOTH armies' eligible units fight in this Fight phase, alternating one at a time (Fights First step, then Remaining Combats step, the active player selecting first in each)
simulator.fight_alternation.effect: Battle._run_fight_alternation resolves the Fight phase faithfully: it collects each army's eligible units (within 1" Engagement Range of an enemy, or having charged this turn) and the players alternate, the active player selecting first, fighting one unit at a time — Fights First units (chargers + the Fights First keyword) first, then the remaining units. Each unit fights at most once per Fight phase; because a battle round runs both players' turns, a unit locked across both turns fights in BOTH fight phases (twice per round, as 10e intends). This makes a charged defender swing back in-phase before it is deleted, removing the over-credit the wave-163 instrument proved differentially favours melee aggressors (denied-retaliation per battle: World Eaters 56.5 vs T'au 1.9). Faithful and faction-neutral (correct even if it moves the metric the wrong way). Default OFF; SWEG_FIGHTALT=1 enables the isolation A/B. The gate-off path runs the original active-only fight loop verbatim, so it is byte-identical.
